name: Concrete-encased duct bank — 4-way 4 in PVC
description: Inspections and tests for an underground concrete-encased duct bank, from trench to backfill and records.

lines.title: Conduit, spacer and fitting submittals accepted
lines.acceptance_criteria: Accepted submittals on file for conduit, spacers, couplings, bends and pull boxes before material is installed

lines.title: Concrete mix design accepted
lines.acceptance_criteria: Accepted mix design on file; strength and color dye as specified

lines.title: Route staked and existing utilities located
lines.acceptance_criteria: Alignment and grades staked; all crossings marked and potholed where shown

lines.title: Trench depth below finished grade
lines.acceptance_criteria: Project-specific value required — verify before issue

lines.title: Trench bottom firm and free of rock and water
lines.acceptance_criteria: No standing water, no rock or debris larger than 1 in on the bed

lines.title: Conduit size, count and spacer spacing
lines.acceptance_criteria: Four 4 in conduits per drawing; spacers at the interval shown, conduits held in position

lines.title: Joints glued and bends within allowed total per run
lines.acceptance_criteria: Every joint solvent-welded; total bends between pull points within the allowed total

lines.title: Conduits anchored against flotation
lines.acceptance_criteria: Tie-downs at the interval shown; no conduit lifted before or during the pour

lines.title: Duct bank released for concrete encasement
lines.acceptance_criteria: Lines 4–8 complete and accepted; conduit ends capped; mandrel test passed on every conduit

lines.title: Concrete cover around outer conduits
lines.acceptance_criteria: Project-specific value required — verify before issue

lines.title: Concrete delivery tickets checked
lines.acceptance_criteria: Mix matches the accepted design; water added recorded; time since batching within the specified limit

lines.title: Slump
lines.acceptance_criteria: Project-specific value required — verify before issue

lines.title: Warning tape placed above the duct bank
lines.acceptance_criteria: Continuous tape at the depth shown, full width of the bank

lines.title: Backfill compaction
lines.acceptance_criteria: Project-specific value required — verify before issue

lines.title: Mandrel pulled through every conduit after backfill
lines.acceptance_criteria: Mandrel passes end to end in every conduit; pull string left in place

lines.title: As-built route and depths recorded
lines.acceptance_criteria: As-built drawing shows alignment, depths and crossings

notes: Assumed one straight run with two pull boxes; add lines for each pull box if the drawings show more.
Burial depth, concrete cover, slump and compaction depend on the project — fill them in from the drawings and specifications.
Confirm every value against the project documents before issue.
